description: Verify that DUT does NOT reassemble fragments whose Source Address fields differ — Source Address is part of the reassembly bucket key (RFC 791 §3.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Same-id fragments from different sources are different datagrams (the same id space is per-source). Mixing them would let an attacker hijack reassembly.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: fragment 0 with src_ip = SRC_A (MF=1)
2. Tester → DUT: fragment 1 with src_ip = SRC_B (MF=0, same id otherwise)
   ⇒ Different buckets — no reassembly should happen.

3. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: no Echo Reply

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any Echo Reply within the window.

[Fail condition]
Same as IPV4_FRAGMENTS_02 — Fail_early_reply / Fail_echo_id / Fail_echo_seq / Fail_data_mismatch indicate cross-source merging.

verdicts.Pass: DUT did not merge fragments from different sources — normal
verdicts.Fail_early_reply: DUT replied — merged fragments from different src_ips
